evidence.exact_quote: Democrats have crossed the threshold of 218 seats required to win the majority.
In the US Senate, Democrats have managed to flip several Republican seats, winning races in Republican strongholds such as North Carolina, South Carolina, Kansas, Texas, and Iowa.

Despite the significant executive power delegated to the presidency according to the US Constitution, the majority of federal political decisions have to be approved by Congress before they can be implemented.

framing_claims.text: DW presenta el resultado de las midterms como una victoria de los demócratas que les permite controlar ambas cámaras del Congreso, resaltando también los cambios demográficos que favorecen a su coalición.
